---
title: "Collapse Data by Blocks"
format: html
---

## Block level data

Load block polygons and SATP data as sf objects.

```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)

# Read in the data
satp_df <- read_csv("../data/satp_clean.csv")

# Reading in SHRUG block polygons
block_data <- st_read("data-large/shrug-pc11subdist-poly-gpkg/subdistrict.gpkg")

# Convert SATP data to an sf object 
event_sf <- satp_df |>
    drop_na(longitude, latitude) |> # Drop rows with missing coordinates
    st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), 
             crs = st_crs(block_data))
```

Check coordinate systems of the two data frames.

```{r}
st_crs(event_sf)
st_crs(block_data)
```

Check for valid geometries.

```{r}
all(st_is_valid(event_sf))
all(st_is_valid(block_data))
```

Check for spatial overlap.

```{r}
plot(st_geometry(block_data))
plot(st_geometry(event_sf), add = TRUE, col = "red")
```

Do a spatial join of block boundaries and geocoded events.

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Perform the spatial join: this will add polygon attributes to the event data
events_with_polygons <- st_join(event_sf, block_data, join = st_within) |>
  relocate(geometry:subdistrict_name, .after = village_name) |>
  relocate(subdistrict_name, .after = block) |>
    relocate(constituency, .after = subdistrict_name)  

# Check the result
glimpse(events_with_polygons)
```


Aggregate events by polygon.

```{r}
event_counts <- events_with_polygons |>
  group_by(village_id) |>  
  summarize(event_count = n())
```

Merge back in with polygon data and visualize 

```{r}
polygons_with_counts <- left_join(polygons, event_counts, by = "village_id")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = polygons_with_counts, aes(fill = event_count), color = "black") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  labs(title = "Event Counts per Polygon",
       fill = "Event Count",
       x = "Longitude",
       y = "Latitude")
```

Take the sum of events in the polygon.

```{r}
# Replace 'village_id' with your polygon identifier column
# Replace 'event_value' with the column you want to sum up
aggregated_data <- events_with_polygons %>%
  group_by(village_id) %>%
  summarize(total_value = sum(event_value, na.rm = TRUE))

# Merge the aggregated sums back into the polygon data
polygons_with_sums <- left_join(polygons, aggregated_data, by = "village_id")
```

## Additional stuff

Map the polygons (integrated with gpkg data below).

```{r}
library(sf)
library(rmapshaper)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggthemes)

# Split the data into smaller chunks
chunks <- split(dbf_data, dbf_data$pc11_s_id)  # Example: split by state

# Simplify each chunk
simplified_chunks <- lapply(chunks, function(chunk) {
  ms_simplify(chunk, keep = 0.05, keep_shapes = TRUE)
})

# Combine the simplified chunks back into a single object
simplified_data <- do.call(rbind, simplified_chunks)

# Plot the simplified data
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = simplified_data) +
  theme_map()
```
